scope: Hatoyama Hall in Otowa, Tokyo, in 2006. The house includes the west stone porte-cochère and arched entry, the projecting south garden rooms and the roof of the reinforced-concrete mansion.

originalReview.notes: The west entrance shows the pale stone arch on square piers, glazed fanlight, shallow porch step and the straight interior staircase visible through the opening.
The elevated view establishes the open garden side and the drop from the south-facing rooms toward the garden. The model scope is the hall itself.

quallaSearch.notes: The exact 2006 Qualla entrance and garden originals are both self-released by the photographer Lombroso. The entrance view supplies the arch and stair detail; the garden view establishes the garden orientation.
